milestones.title: Fix It In Place
milestones.joke: A tag changes without a rebuild.
milestones.when: shell output: a successful `tofu apply` whose output shows a resource `Modifying...` (an in-place change). Needs the terminal under tmux, which the browser terminal is

milestones.title: Rebuilt from Scratch
milestones.joke: The message forces a new container.
milestones.when: shell output: a successful `tofu apply` that prints a destroy then a create; or cloud: the container was deleted and created again (or swapped) by the same student within 2 minutes

milestones.title: Because I Said So
milestones.when: shell: `tofu apply -replace=...` (exit 0) in Track B (after the credentials milestone)
